name: Air Fryer Chicken Schnitzel with Mashed Potatoes

components.name: Chicken Schnitzel

ingredients.name: Raw boneless chicken breast, thin cutlets

steps: Cut chicken into evenly thin schnitzel portions and season lightly. Prepare flour, beaten egg and panko mixed with parmesan and lemon pepper in separate shallow bowls.
Coat cutlets in flour, egg, then the crumb mixture. Rest chilled for 15 minutes so coating adheres.
Preheat air fryer to 180 C. Spray the cutlets with measured oil, air fry in batches approximately 14-17 minutes until golden and 74 C inside.
Portion schnitzel, mash and greens equally; keep any fresh lemon on the side. Reheat the chicken in the air fryer for crunch.

components.name: Mashed Potatoes & Greens
steps: Simmer potatoes until tender, drain and mash with warm milk, butter and salt. Steam green beans or broccoli separately.

Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
